messages:
alex_k: Quick heads-up — we prototyped an SDK flag to allow graceful degrade to a cheaper model when routing/quotas block the primary route. sketch: `allow_graceful_degrade=True` in client config.

maria_devex: Love the idea. Can you outline how this interacts with routing policy headers and our telemetry?

alex_k: Short version: SDK will send `X-Redwood-RouteHint: degrade=allow` when the flag is true. Platform can decide: 1) honor and return fallback variant, or 2) ignore and return 429/403. SDK will treat fallback variant as success and tag traces with `sdk.degrade=fallback`.

eli_platform: Need to be careful — that header is effectively a request to bypass quota enforcement. Platform must keep audit logs and metric labels. Also we should gate with a feature flag on our side: `platform.accept_degrade_hint` so we can opt-in by customer and by region.

sam_engineering: If SDK silently treats fallback as success, product teams might see different quality. We should add a visible signal in responses so apps can show a degraded UX. Maybe a response field: `redwood_degraded: true` and `degrade_reason: "quota"|"latency"`.

alex_k: Agreed. Plan in SDK v0.24: opt-in boolean in constructors, telemetry tag, and response passthrough of `redwood_degraded`. Example python snip: 
```
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=..., allow_graceful_degrade=True)
resp = client.generate("summarize ...")
if resp.meta.get('redwood_degraded'):
    # show compact UX
    show_simple_card(resp.text)
```

maria_devex: Console changes: add toggle per-organization to allow degrade hints + dashboard tile for `fallback_rate` and `median_quality_delta` (compare baseline evals). UX needs a tooltip explaining tradeoffs and recommended guardrails.

eli_platform: Also add routing telemetry: label `route_hint=degrade` and `degrade_outcome={honored,ignored}`. We can track fallout: percent of honored hints that were fallback vs percent that resulted in hard reject.

sasha_pm: Acceptable rollout plan? My proposal: behind SDK opt-in beta + platform flag in staging, then 10% of orgs in prod with console opt-in, measure fallback_rate, user complaints, and quality regressions for 2 weeks.

alex_k: Yep. One more compatibility concern: older proxies may strip unknown headers. SDK should encode hint also in metadata body field `route.hint` so proxies that preserve body still work. Backwards compat: if both header and body present, header wins.

qa_roshan: Tests: add integration test that simulates quota-full and asserts SDK gets degraded model and telemetry event `sdk.degrade.fallback`. Also unit test for header+body encoding. I'll add tests to the CI matrix.

sam_engineering: Docs & changelog: mark this as non-breaking (opt-in) but call out that default might flip in 2 quarters. If we flip default, we must coordinate with product and send migration emails.

maria_devex: One last ask — add an event type for our usage pipeline: `degrade_signal` with fields [org_id, route, reason, outcome, model_from, model_to]. That will help billing and quality analysis.

eli_platform: I'll add the fields and the platform flag. Alex — can you open a short RFC (2 pages) with header/body schema, telemetry names, and rollout steps? Put it in the eng-platform backlog and tag `devex` & `product`.

alex_k: Will do. Drafting RFC now, will ping for reviews. Thanks all :thumbsup:
